LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making? 2. Why do people make notes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: The learners are interacting with technology as they use electronic devices to get information.

● Creativity and imagination: The learners create their own abbreviations and display on a chart,

● Communication and collaboration: The learners work in groups to discuss words used in writing.

Values:
Respect is promoted as the learners work together to accomplish tasks

Link to other subjects:

Note making skills are invaluable in all subjects as it is part of the array of study skills necessary across the board
